criteria.description: Availability-aware ranked match: system ranks more-available candidate above equally-skilled out-of-window candidate; output includes match%, rationale, gaps
Hard match: when no perfect candidate exists, return closest available people with explicit gap/ramp-up analysis; never return empty
Failure path: Claude unreachable or invalid JSON -> exact message 'Search is temporarily unavailable — please retry.'; no partial/garbled ranking shown
Role gate: Employee is denied access; Practice Lead sees only their team; no cross-scope data leak
Partial-quantity fulfillment: when fewer candidates qualify than requested, return available ones with an explicit shortfall note
